rqs.question: Do compression opportunities broadly exist in natural coding-agent trajectories?

claims.claim: High-frequency large-payload opportunity shapes exist across two independent public corpora
claims.limitation: TW incidence medians/payload stats quoted elsewhere are pre-amendment frozen-ledger values; incidence calibers differ slightly (path-aware normalization applied to OSW side; see L6); TW session identity = recorded-trajectory (row) caliber (A1R3; 13,053 unique identifiers over 15,000 recorded trajectories)

rqs.question: Are major/high-incidence opportunity shapes replicated across independent corpora?

claims.claim: Major/high-incidence opportunity shapes replicated across two independent coding-agent corpora (8/13 measurable shapes REPLICATED or PARTIAL: R7 E1/E2/E3/E9/E12/E13/E14 + P1 E5; all six core shapes REPLICATED with full-precision ratios 0.79-1.28; five sparse shapes E6/E7/E10/E11/E15 DATASET_SPECIFIC, corpus-composition-sensitive)
claims.metric: replication band (incidence ratio 0.5-2.0 = REPLICATED; full precision, exact fractions; TW numerator at trajectory-identity caliber)
claims.limitation: E4 NOT_MEASURABLE in OSW (no range field) — schema limitation, not a negative result; sparse-shape band assignments are corpus-composition-sensitive (A1R2 multiplied discovery-side validation events for E6/E7/E10/E11/E15 while OSW stayed sparse); exact TW-vs-OSW same-caliber comparison under the recovered frame remains future work (L6)

rqs.question: Do opportunities depend on the model?

claims.claim: All six core shapes MODEL_STABLE within both scaffolds (E1/E2/E3/E12/E13/E14 ratios 0.68-1.013)
claims.limitation: sparse shapes (E5-E7/E10/E11) MODEL_SENSITIVE verdicts are low-incidence ratio noise

rqs.question: How does agent scaffold modulate opportunity (within this evaluation frame)?

claims.claim: Within this controlled 2x2 evaluation frame, E13 scaffold-associated variation (mean 28.2pp) exceeds model-associated variation (mean 12.7pp) with 16.5pp interaction, direction-consistent across models — association within the frame, no causal generalization
claims.metric: E13 2x2 four-cell incidence + four contrasts + DiD interaction
claims.limitation: 2x2 proves association within this evaluation frame; no causal generalization to all agent architectures

rqs.question: How much of the natural compression opportunity does the existing system cover?

claims.claim: Production (shipped-only) coverage: SOC 2.07% / COC 0.39% — shipped capabilities near-zero coverage of natural repeated-delivery opportunities
claims.limitation: shipped ledger must not be mixed with research ledger (L4)

claims.claim: Research (shipped + RDS candidate) coverage: SOC 100% / COC 90.13%; Capability Gap Rate 99.57%
claims.limitation: RDS = CAPABILITY_CANDIDATE / DEFAULT_OFF (D3-E8); research ledger must not imply production coverage (L4)

claims.claim: Capability Gap Rate 99.57%: nearly all qualified-opportunity bytes lack a shipped primitive
claims.limitation: gap concentrates in repeated-delivery shapes covered only by RDS candidate

negative_results_preserved: E13 mechanical dedup only 3.5% — large != compressible (D3-E2)
terminal-state classifier opportunity 0% in natural tasks (D2)
RDS online benefit NOT_ESTABLISHED at practical sample sizes (E7 power)
E4 overlapping-read NOT_MEASURABLE in OSW (schema field absent)

claims.limitation: derived from D5 24-pair two-rep structure; applies to comparable model/workload regimes (L7)
